import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from src.util import slugify
cases = [('Hello, World!','hello-world'), ('  Foo Bar  ','foo-bar'), ('---a---','a'), ('',''), ('C++ && Rust','c-rust')]
bad=0
for inp,exp in cases:
    got=slugify(inp)
    ok = got==exp
    bad += 0 if ok else 1
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), repr(inp), '->', repr(got), 'expected', repr(exp))
print('---')
print('docstring present:', bool(slugify.__doc__))
print('failures:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
"
